title: Overwhelming evidence of subsidence on the Atlantic floor along the Mid-Atlantic Ridge

tellings.quote: it's right there. There is overwhelming evidence of major subsidance on the floor the Atlant the floor of the Atlantic Ocean, particularly concentrated along the mid-Atlantic ridge.

plain: The floor of the Atlantic Ocean shows overwhelming evidence of major sinking, most of it along the Mid-Atlantic Ridge, the long underwater mountain chain running down the middle of the ocean. The researcher Randall Carlson says this himself, without naming a source, and ties it to the dialogues of the ancient Greek philosopher Plato, the Timaeus and the Critias, which tell of the sunken island of Atlantis. If he is right, the old story of a land that sank into the Atlantic would have real geology behind it.
